matmul_row_tiles.note: Maximum row tiles sharing B DMA. Up to32 tiles occupy512 accumulator rows, within selected i9 per-bank address window. 1 preserves original baseline.

conv_prepare.note: Generic, automatic or structured convolution input preparation; auto_pool adds exact explicit padded-plane device pooling to auto.

sibling_fusion.note: Explicit true/auto shares LHS across exact siblings; rhs shares immutable RHS across 2..8 exact one-M-tile products. rhs_auto accepts the pinned eight-member shape predicate and internal column schedule, otherwise retains the incumbent. Source effects, aliases and capacity are proven independently. Explicit rhs_rows combines independent short A slices in device scratchpad when total rows<=16; original buffers remain exposed. Within accepted rhs_auto groups, M=1 combines eight physical A rows. Prior rhs+columns4 remains available as the incumbent.

storage_reuse.note: Share internal allocation slots with disjoint static lifetimes; false retains independent allocation incumbent.

attention_key_prepare.note: Row-per-key attention preparation: CPU incumbent or exact device DMA transpose; pretransposed inputs unchanged.

row_policy.note: fixed retains chosen maximum. reuse_large caps to16 when M>128 and K>=128, otherwise8; maximum matmul_row_tiles remains a cap. Provisional model choice with limited boundary holdouts. Optional unroll_reuse preserves the reuse_large residency and statically issues full groups of at most16 row tiles; tail groups retain loops. This is an experimental alternative; default remains reuse_large pending complete-call cycles.

resident_weights.note: Retain bounded full-K i8 RHS in a disjoint scratchpad window for repeated packed-generation consumers; otherwise common streaming lowering.

conv_pack.note: Exact byte packing through raw scratchpad readout or sign-extended accumulator identity readout.

activation_residency.note: Retain full contiguous A in disjoint bounded scratchpad. Auto selects 2<=M<=16,N>=32; pinned GEMV M=1,K>=128,N>=128; or M>16,N>=128. Semantic/layout/capacity legality remains separate. Explicit true/false retain alternatives. Multirow profitability supported by paired M49K512N2048 development and M196K256N1024 holdout; other geometries remain extrapolation.

conv_pointwise_source.note: For unpadded nonunit-stride 1x1 convolution, use common matmul with physical lhs row stride instead of im2col roundtrip. Packed is the tested incumbent.

activation_rows.note: Full-A retained row budget beginning at256, within selected16384-row scratchpad and disjoint other windows. Default8192 follows paired provisional complete-model holdouts;256 retains small-capacity incumbent.

matmul_column_tiles.note: Auto uses shared dimension policy, pinned GEMV M1 K,N>=128, and exact-bit repeated-scale layout for M,K,N>=128 with all scale groups>=16; legality separate. Explicit1/2/4/permute remain alternatives.

column_dma.note: In shared multi-column lowering, one wide state1 MVIN uses block_stride16 for up to64 adjacent i8 columns. Tile retains separate loads. Uses the common terminal encoder; maximum64byte read requests are a hardware bound, not a promised transfer size.

tiled_bias.note: Initialize each tiled accumulator from signed i32 bias before reduction using state2 DMA; false retains incumbent bias lowering.

conv_pack_dma.note: Tile, wide channels, scanline rows, or guarded padded scanline rows; all use shared DMA encoding.

peel_reduction.note: Peel the real first K tile and use constant subsequent accumulation flags; false retains the incumbent reduction loop.
